# 10 — `modDesc.xml`

The mod descriptor at the mod root. Registers the mod and its playable map(s) with the game. Generated by
`tools/gen_configs.py`. If this is malformed the map silently **does not appear in the map list** (the mod loads
but the map fails to register).

## Structure

```xml
<modDesc descVersion="100">
    <author>fs25-empty-map</author>
    <version>1.0.0.0</version>
    <title><en>Empty 16x</en></title>
    <description><en>...</en></description>
    <iconFilename>icon.dds</iconFilename>              <!-- (A) mod-level icon -->
    <maps>
        <map id="Empty16x" className="Mission00" filename="$dataS/scripts/mission00.lua"
             configFilename="maps/map.xml"
             defaultVehiclesXMLFilename="maps/vehicles.xml"
             defaultPlaceablesXMLFilename="maps/placeables.xml"
             defaultItemsXMLFilename="maps/items.xml"
             defaultHandToolsXMLFilename="$data/maps/mapUS/config/handTools.xml">
            <title><en>Empty 16x</en></title>
            <iconFilename>icon.dds</iconFilename>       <!-- (B) map-level icon -->
        </map>
    </maps>
</modDesc>
```

## Elements

| element | meaning |
|---------|---------|
| `modDesc@descVersion` | modDesc schema version. The game logs `ModDesc Version: 110` (its max supported). A mod value ≤ that loads; we use **100** (matches shipping maps). |
| `author`, `version` (x.x.x.x) | metadata; version is 4-part. |
| `title`/`description` `<en>` | localized strings; `<en>` is the fallback. |
| `iconFilename` (mod-level) | child element → the mod's tile icon, a `.dds`. |
| `maps` / `map` | one `<map>` per playable map in the mod. |
| `map@id` | internal id. `map@className`/`filename` = the mission script (`Mission00` / `$dataS/scripts/mission00.lua`, base-game). |
| `map@configFilename` | → `maps/map.xml` (see 20_mapxml.md). |
| `map@default{Vehicles,Placeables,Items}XMLFilename` | starting-farm content; must exist (empty files are fine). |
| `map@defaultHandToolsXMLFilename` | `$data/maps/mapUS/config/handTools.xml` (base-game). |
| `map`/`title` | the name shown in the map list. |
| `map`/`iconFilename` | **child element** → the map's preview `.dds`. |

## GOTCHAS (each cost a load)

1. **`iconFilename` is required in TWO places**: the mod-level (A) *and* inside every `<map>` (B). Missing (B) →
   `Error: Failed to load map '...'. Missing element 'modDesc.maps.map(0).iconFilename'.` → **map absent from list**.
2. **`map`/`iconFilename` is a CHILD ELEMENT, not an attribute.** `<map ... iconFilename="icon.dds">` is silently
   ignored (the parser wants `<iconFilename>icon.dds</iconFilename>` inside `<map>`).
3. The default vehicles/placeables/items XMLs referenced must exist. We emit empty `<vehicles></vehicles>` etc.

## The icon
A `.dds` image. We generate a solid 256×256 uncompressed (BGRA) DDS via PIL (`Image.new("RGBA",...).save(".dds")`) —
magic `DDS `, 128-byte header + 256·256·4 pixel bytes. Cosmetic, but its **absence from the `<map>` blocks the map**.
